advisories: the target answered with x-mainline-emulator: local_furl. This run was taken against scripts/deploy/local_furl.py — the REAL demo-api handler and the REAL console bundle, over a local socket, against the database named under /v1/health. It proves the handler, the site and the gate. It does NOT prove that a public demo URL exists; docs/submission/SUBMISSION.json holds UNRESOLVED until one does.

/v1/health reports migrations_applied=0, and that is a true count of the wrong ledger rather than a broken deployment. health.py's statement counts trappoint.schema_migration WHERE state='applied'; the only writer of that table in the tree is trappoint_migrate/runner.py:295, i.e. `trappoint migrate up`. This database was built by scripts/deploy/cloud_chain.py, which bootstraps the attestation ledger (hence the non-null schema_fingerprint above) and then applies the 271 files itself, recording its count in trappoint.deploy_chain instead. So schema_migration is empty by construction, 0 is honest about it, and the chain really is applied — the schema_fingerprint above is the identifier that moves when the schema does. Two appliers, two ledgers, and /v1/health reads only one of them.
note: THE COMMITTED TREE, UNMODIFIED, AGAINST A DEMO-SEEDED DATABASE, ON 2026-08-13. Target: scripts/deploy/local_furl.py serving the UNMODIFIED mainline_demo_api.app.handler (banner: handler D:/CoackroachDBxAWS/mainline/verticals/mainline/apps/demo-api/src/mainline_demo_api/app.py) and the real console dist over an emulated Lambda Function URL payload-2.0 event. NO MONKEYPATCHING: this run imports nothing of its own into the handler's process. The database is w_w4_acceptance on the pinned local node, built by scripts/deploy/cloud_chain.py (271/271 applied, 0 failed, 0 retries, 115.2s) and seeded by scripts/deploy/seed_demo.py from verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_world.sql + demo_permit.sql - THE SAME TWO SEED FILES THAT BUILT THE LIVE CockroachDB Cloud DATABASE mainline_demo, chosen for exactly that reason. seed_demo.py's own verifier reported SEEDED AND REFUSABLE, state=dispositioned open_blocking=1 gate_epoch=1 head_seq=2, MERGE REFUSED [23514] gate_closed_when_issued, rollback nothing_persisted=True. TWO DEFECTS REMAIN, BOTH OUTSIDE THIS WORKER'S FILES, BOTH NAMED WITH THE LINE THAT CAUSES THEM. (1) refusal.py:235 returns row[0] on a row the connection produced with dict_row, and the statement above it is SELECT trappoint.explain_refusal(...) whose single column CockroachDB names explain_refusal - so row[0] is KeyError: 0. Beats 2 and 3 both reach it through gate_run._record_refusal -> refusal_payload -> _explain, so no path through the demo avoids it and every gate run answers 500. This is the SAME defect class as the one w1-rowfactory was dispatched to remove; w1 fixed its three owned modules, found this fourth site, measured it, wrote the one-line correction into evidence/deploy/rowfactory-defect.json -> blocking_finding, and did not edit it because no worker in this wave owns refusal.py. It is still unowned. (2) Behind it, beat 4 cannot admit on a demo-seeded database at all: see corroborating_run, which is itself NOT PROVEN. gate_run.py:576,578 hard-code the credential ids that scripts/proof/gate_refusal.py:844 seeds, while the demo seeds write different ones, so the disposition INSERT violates disposition_signer_credential_id_fkey with 23503. The two are not interchangeable: gate_refusal.py:843 seeds signer_sub 'proof.signer' whereas scenario.py:209 defaults signer_sub to 'demo.signer', which is the DEMO seeder's subject - so gate_run.py writes one seeder's subject beside the other seeder's credential in a single INSERT. THIS MATTERS FOR THE APPLY: the Lambda the founder approved points MAINLINE_DEMO_DATABASE at mainline_demo, which is demo-seeded, so the headline beat would refuse with a foreign-key violation in front of a judge. The correction that fits this repository's own doctrine is a lookup, not a new constant: scenario.py's docstring says a derived identifier the API pinned would be the API asserting a fact about rows it did not write, and MEASURED on this database, SELECT credential_id FROM mainline.signing_credential WHERE signer_sub = %s AND revoked_at IS NULL resolves 'demo.signer' to ff356d14... and 'demo.countersigner' to 8d7b089f..., which is the shape gate_run.py already uses for every other identifier it needs. WHAT THIS RUN DOES ESTABLISH, and did not before: the permit was read BEFORE and AFTER both gate runs from GET /v1/permits/{id} - a different endpoint in a different transaction - and open_blocking, state, gate_epoch and head_seq are identical across before_run_1, after_run_1 and after_run_2. That reading was taken even though both gate runs answered 500, which is the case the 2026-08-11 artefact could not cover: the re-read used to sit on the success path behind a continue, so the one run where 'did anything persist?' most needed an answer was the one run that could not give it. NOTHING IN THIS FILE WAS RELAXED TO REACH A GREEN. The four expectations are the ones docs/deploy/gate-run-contract.md states; this run does not meet them; the verdict is NOT PROVEN and the apply is NO-GO until both defects above are closed by their owners.

corroborating_run.note: SCRATCHPAD DIAGNOSTIC, NOT THE ACCEPTANCE RUN, AND ITS VERDICT IS ALSO NOT PROVEN. Identical to the primary run in every respect except one: mainline_demo_api.refusal._explain was replaced, in this process only, by the same function taking the row's single VALUE instead of row[0] - the one-line correction evidence/deploy/rowfactory-defect.json -> blocking_finding.correction already specifies. NO REPOSITORY FILE WAS EDITED; the patch lives in a scratchpad wrapper that imports scripts/deploy/local_furl.py and serves the otherwise unmodified handler. It exists to answer one question the primary run cannot reach past refusal.py:235: with that line corrected, does the DEMO-SEEDED database drive all four beats? ANSWER, measured on 2026-08-13 against w_w4_acceptance - built by scripts/deploy/cloud_chain.py (271/271 applied, 0 failed) and seeded by scripts/deploy/seed_demo.py, i.e. verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_world.sql + demo_permit.sql, THE SAME TWO FILES THAT SEEDED THE LIVE CockroachDB Cloud DATABASE mainline_demo: THREE of the four beats, not four. POST /v1/demo/gate-run answers 200; beats 1-3 produce 00000, 23514 gate_closed_when_issued (reported) and P0001 mainline.fn_permit_merge_gate (parsed); the two runs are identical on the stable projection; persisted is false and the permit is unchanged after both runs. Beat 4 is REFUSED 23503 disposition_signer_credential_id_fkey, and that is a SECOND defect standing behind the first. gate_run.py:576,578 writes signer_credential_id = sha256('cred'+'signer') = 487adc50409e8811b1f12055ee183ce9d8548f11262807d01776fb67cd09c765 and countersigner_credential_id = sha256('cred'+'cosigner') = 916b6121c8188a00ec5deff08e61ea034a58ed16d8ec85115c40cf7cb049d7fb. Those two values are seeded by scripts/proof/gate_refusal.py:844 and by nothing else. The demo seeds write digest('mainline-demo/credential/demo.signer','sha256') = ff356d1461921438bbbc5d644db8793669cb948a46bddc2e8fb5ebef959bdf0c and digest('mainline-demo/credential/demo.countersigner','sha256') = 8d7b089f4c0aec7d890810a5aca3ebd9f57e2ae8786e2749e576200019b18ebe. Measured: SELECT signer_sub, encode(credential_id,'hex') FROM mainline.signing_credential on this database returns exactly those two demo rows and neither gate_run.py constant. NOTHING IN THIS FILE WAS RELAXED TO REACH A GREEN: the four expectations are the ones docs/deploy/gate-run-contract.md states, and this run does not meet them either.
